name: AI Vision & Text Recognition (AI & OCR)
description: Provides screen text recognition (OCR), text search, table extraction, barcode scanning, LLM chat, and intelligent visual element locating

OpenAiService.description: Invoke local or remote AI models for chat and inference, generating text or structured data

OcrGeneral.description: Accurately recognize all text in an image or screen region, outputting full text and bounding boxes

OcrFindText.description: Search for specific text on the screen or image and return its coordinates for clicking

VisualWait.description: Wait for specific text or visual element to appear or disappear on the screen

OcrTable.description: Automatically recognize table structure in images and reconstruct structured tabular data

BarcodeRecognition.description: Recognize QR codes and 1D barcodes from images or screen with high fault tolerance

BarcodeGenerate.description: Generate barcode or QR code image from given text or URL

Florence2.description: Locate UI elements, buttons, or icons using natural language descriptions via Florence-2 model

ObjectDetection.description: Detect and locate objects, persons, vehicles, or items in the image

ImageClassification.description: Classify image category, type, or scene content automatically
